cohort: The study included 26 pregnant women who underwent breech vaginal delivery (cases) and 52 pregnant women who underwent cephalic vaginal delivery (controls) in a Portuguese hospital.
finding: The study found no significant differences in neonatal and maternal morbidity between breech vaginal delivery at term and cephalic presentation.
mod_finding: Breech vaginal delivery, when performed at term under strict selection criteria and with an experienced obstetrician, was suggested to remain a safe option.
birth_weight: 2,805 g (breech vaginal delivery group) vs 3,177 g (cephalic vaginal delivery group)
